title: A Convex-Analytic Reformulation for Poisoning Attacks on Logistic Regression
abstract: arXiv:2611.17143v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study data poisoning attacks on logistic regression with $\ell_2$-regularization, where an attacker chooses the features of a fixed number of injected observations with prescribed labels to maximize the logistic loss on the clean training data. Strong convexity of the defender's problem yields an exact reformulation through its first-order optimality conditions. Using convex conjugacy of the softplus function, we replace the sigmoid relations by a single convex optimality-gap inequality and express the attacker's objective as a concave function. A change of variables makes the stationarity condition affine, leaving bounded bilinear equalities as the only nonconvex constraints. We derive finite bounds on all variables involved in these equalities, including a global bound on the coefficient norm and tighter bounds obtained by preprocessing based on convex optimization. translated_title: 针对逻辑回归投毒攻击的凸分析重构方法
translated_abstract: 我们研究了带 $\ell_2$ 正则化的逻辑回归上的数据投毒攻击问题，其中攻击者在标签被预先指定的情况下，选择固定数量注入观测样本的特征，以最大化干净训练数据上的逻辑损失。由于防御者问题具有强凸性，我们可以通过其一阶最优性条件对其进行精确重构。利用 softplus 函数的凸共轭性，我们用单一的凸最优性间隙不等式替代了 sigmoid 关系，并将攻击者的目标表示为凹函数。通过变量替换，平稳性条件变为仿射形式，使得有界的双线性等式成为唯一的非凸约束。我们推导出这些等式中所有涉及变量的有限界，包括系数范数的全局界，以及通过基于凸优化的预处理获得的更紧的界。在八个二分类数据集上的实验评估了……
tldr: 本文将针对带 ℓ2 正则化逻辑回归的投毒攻击问题重构为一种凸分析形式，使有界双线性等式成为唯一的非凸约束，并为所有变量推导出有限界。
en_tdlr: This paper reformulates poisoning attacks on ℓ2-regularized logistic regression into a convex-analytic form where bounded bilinear equalities are the only nonconvex constraints, deriving finite bounds for all involved variables.
